svg.text: F279.2 · Requests and calculation calls
Design only. User approved both conventions on 2026-09-11; implementation follows the queued migrations.
1 · Fresh-unit starting convention
Template / innate / training → evidenced initial calculation
Preserve damage + context; selected casts are not preloaded.
Unknown required retained state blocks the affected input domain.
2 · Temporary whole-run selection
All dependencies qualified → new executor below
Otherwise → existing flat path once, reported explicitly
No mixing; workaround removal owner: F279.5.
Run state and ordered requests
Persistent carriers | Calculated / battle record | External authored inputs + mutable context
Existing assumed request order; innate/global/recalculation producers remain at their own sites.
Attempt next marked effect
Read the actual admission record/time.
Admitted writes occur once.
Refused ≠ unchanged store ≠ skipped reader.
Follow this branch's actual continuation
Call the shared faithful pass only where equivalence is established.
Otherwise preserve the narrower/different schedule and arguments.
Carry persistent/retained/context writes forward. Never replay an earlier cast.
DOS calls · retain enclosing version schedule
Constructor: selected resets and local writes
↳ Specials (copied P1 OR I1, M1; CoM mask rule)
Constructor tail → battlefield modifiers
↳ Specials (copied B2 AND NOT P2, M2 or 0)
Battlefield tail / clamps / separate HP rebuild
MoM M2 is a separate saved mutation byte; CP/CoM pass 0.
MoM Holy Weapon is inline in constructor, not Specials.
Modern full engine pass · retain actual scope
First eligible-unit loop: save retained movement
Base → calculated copy; merge separate carriers
Versioned calculation / hooks / persistent writes
Build aura table → later eligible-unit loop
Combat script precedes pass; overland hook follows it.
Handler-entry model does not establish first/only animation use.
All-unit/aura dependencies cannot be replaced by invented context.
One execution ledger → complete ledger + sparse hover projection
Source ID owns citation. Invocation ID owns call, arguments and parent. Occurrence ID owns each write.
Admission, copy/reset, both Specials calls and unchanged/skipped outcomes retain their execution positions.
Migration: F271 → F279.3a representation → F279.3c executor → F279.3b Holy Weapon
Coverage includes innate, training, globals and recalculation producers; later owners extend it. F279.5 removes fallback.
The linked design and existing evidence own detailed conditions. No new implementation, binary reconstruction or task is authorized here.
